verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own CLI can run a local model offline and launch a tool against a model with one command. That implies it starts local model execution from the terminal, but the evidence never describes a local model server or a stop command, and one docs note says the on-device SDKs have no HTTP surface. missing for 10: an explicitly documented local server mode, a stop/shutdown command, server lifecycle and status management, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
One command points a tool at a model and starts it.
